global._comment_results_dir: Custom Results directory path. null = default 'Results' folder. Example: 'E:/desktop/DCE/test' or '/path/to/custom/results'

cone_sampling._comment_cone_sampling: Cone sampling configuration for gradient guidance
cone_sampling._comment_cone_cat: true: use cone sampling for categorical features, false: random sampling
cone_sampling._comment_cone_cont: true: use cone sampling for continuous features, false: random sampling

explain_data._comment_explain_data: Data selection method for generating counterfactual explanations
explain_data._usage_standard: For standard: set method='standard', only sample_num needed
explain_data._usage_risk_filter: For risk_filter: set method='risk_filter', sample_num + risk_filter (0=low, 1=high)
explain_data._usage_fixed_indices: For fixed_indices: set method='fixed_indices', provide fixed_indices array
explain_data._comment_sample_num: Number of samples to explain. For fixed_indices: should match array length
explain_data._comment_risk_filter: For risk_filter method only: 0 (low risk samples) or 1 (high risk samples)

strategies._comment_strategies: Available: monte_carlo, genetic, simulated_annealing, bayesian, differential_evolution
strategies.name: monte_carlo
